look: JustShoot Kodak Portra 400 + Portra Endura material v1
comparison: Same image, WB/tint neutral, default curve, same preset optics/grain and fixed seed 123; legacy RGB LUT vs material v1. Other presets unchanged.
input_contract: Developed encoded sRGB [0,1]; native existing fixture sizes, new inputs bounded to 2048px long edge. Grain compared only at each scene's common size.
limits: This is an SDR implementation comparison, not a SpektraLab render comparison or a calibrated film-scan comparison.
Existing input clipping/retouching/noise/halation is baked into the source and cannot be recovered.
No physical-device capture, RAW camera calibration or performance measurement.
RGB differences and grain residuals quantify change, not photographic quality.
